title: docs(skills): os-dev.md names check:pm-dispatch-gates as a detached, unlocked check:* gate; its duration reading corrected
body:
Fixes #21786
Clause-②: no

Maintainer-direct card (the order is quoted verbatim in the card body). It carries the remedy measured on objectstack-ai/objectstack#21719, which is closed; nothing here acts on that card.

## What changed: two in-place edits, two files, net 0 lines

### 1. `.claude/agents/os-dev.md`, 〈资源纪律〉 item 1: one added sub-line

After (new line 83, 120 bytes), directly under the unchanged `check:*` sub-line (line 82, 104 bytes):

```text
   - 它不保证机器空闲:`check:*` 门禁、install、dev server 不走它,与持锁同核并跑。
   - 测试电池 `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates` 亦属 `check:*`:不走锁,`nohup … > LOG 2>&1 &` 后 `tail --pid`。
```

Before: no line in the file named the battery. `git grep -n 'pm-dispatch-gates' e83c9f615 -- .claude/agents/os-dev.md` exits 1; the control word `os-verify-lock` in the same file answers 2 hits, exit 0. Item 1's first sentence 「每次 build/test 都从这里走」 is what sent a `check:*`-named test battery into the lock. The new line follows the "Run --self-test DETACHED on an agent container" section of the `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` header (about :28 to :50).

**Why a new line rather than a rewrite of line 82 (dispatch route a).** Route (a) does not fit. Adding only the gate name to the existing sub-line, as 「(含 `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates`)」, measures 140 bytes before any detach prescription, which is over the 120-byte cap. So the line is new, and it is paid for by deleting a restated line from the same file (route b):

| deleted line (old line 203, 〈标准条款住在这里〉, 73 bytes) | owning copy that stays on the reading path |
|---|---|
| `- `origin/main` 是共享指针,别的 agent 一次 fetch 就推进它。` | `AGENTS.md`, Multi-agent working discipline, lines 343 to 344 at `e83c9f615`: "**`refs/remotes/*` is shared** — a sibling's fetch advances **your** `origin/main`" |

The same fact also stays in os-dev.md itself, one line above the deletion (line 200, unchanged): 「共享的含 refs(含 `refs/remotes/*`)、stash 栈、config、hooks;配方不点名共享态才 worktree-safe。」 The line that followed the deleted one (`git reset --soft origin/main` …) still reads correctly after it.

### 2. `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/platform-readings.md`, line 432: edited in place

```text
before (113 bytes): - `check:pm-dispatch-gates` 单机 430–450 秒贴容器上限 ⇒ detach 加 `tail --pid=$!`;超时非读数。
after  (118 bytes): - `check:pm-dispatch-gates` 1216–1246 秒超容器上限 ⇒ 不走锁,detach 加 `tail --pid=$!`;超时非读数。
```

Provenance of the number: these are the holds the lock printed on its own `VERDICT` line for five dev runs in one shift on 2026-10-04. They ran on an agent container through `os-verify-lock.sh -c`: 1239, 1246, 1224, 1216 and about 1222 s, with the battery itself at 1222 to 1245 s over 1976 cases (objectstack-ai/objectstack#21719 body). This PR did not re-measure them, because the battery takes about 20 minutes. The detach plus `tail --pid=$!` prescription and 「超时非读数」 are kept. 「不走锁」 points the same way as edit 1. A per-run unit 「秒/次」 measured 122 bytes, so it was left out; the comparison with the per-command cap already reads as a per-run figure.

### Declared deviation from the dispatch wording

The dispatch spelled the os-dev prescription "tail 日志", after the header's "tail the log file until it stops growing". The line says `tail --pid` instead, for three reasons. The platform-readings row already uses that prescription (`tail --pid=$!`). It is also the only waiting shape os-dev.md 〈干净收尾〉 item 4 allows: 「前台跑完,或 `tail --pid` 等它退出」. A bare "tail the log" can be read as polling, which the same file forbids. The line comes to exactly 120 bytes.

## Not changed

- `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh` and `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` are untouched. The dedicated-slot, run-length-class and self-test-batching routes were rejected at triage, and the latter file is frozen under ruling 208.
- No gate, patrol row or script was added. No file other than the two above changed.

## Line budget

| file | lines before → after | ceiling | edited / added / deleted lines |
|---|---|---|---|
| `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` | 402 → 402 | 402 (unchanged) | +1 (line 83, 120 B) / −1 (old line 203, 73 B) |
| `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/platform-readings.md` | 469 → 469 | 469 (unchanged) | 1 edited in place (line 432, 113 B → 118 B) |

No ceiling was raised, and no lines were gained by re-wrapping.

That run measured nothing and is not a finding. After the build `os-verify-lock.sh -c 'pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/formula --filter=@objectstack/lint'` (`VERDICT command-exit 0 · held the lock 71s`), the rerun printed `22 record-scoped formula example(s) … judged clean` |
| beyond the derivation: `check:pm-settings-deny-roster` · `check-published-list-mirrors.mjs` · `check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` · `check:pm-governed-prose` | 0 each | the roster under `.claude` checked, the mirrors match, and the governed prose names all 6 surfaces |

Reconciliation: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --ran FILE` printed `22 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 22 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 22 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)`. The derivation names its tree as `objectstack-ai/objectstack` at commit `2ea131a3e`, with a change set of 2 paths against merge base `e83c9f615`.

NOT MEASURED locally:
- The two CI-only families: `check-required-contexts --verify-required-set` and `check-half-states --provenance`.
- The four type-check lanes. The diff touches no TypeScript.
- `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates`. It is not derived for this diff and was deliberately not run.

## Acceptance notes

- The card's acceptance, "The next shift's PM-tool dev reports record no locked `check:pm-dispatch-gates` hold", is a future reading that this PR cannot prove. What the PR does prove: both texts landed, and the ratchet, agent-model, id-lint and frame-sync gates are green.
- The card body says "each line is paid in place by tightening a neighbouring line". `os-dev.md` bars re-wrapping as a way to gain lines, so the os-dev line is paid for by deleting a restated line instead (table above).
- The 1216 to 1246 s figure is a shared-box reading: unlocked sibling `check:*` work ran beside the holder. On a quiet container the header says the battery fits inside the cap. The 120-byte row has no room to state that condition, so it is recorded here.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么**:开发 agent 手册「资源纪律」第 1 条新增一行,写明 `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates` 这条约 20 分钟的自测电池属于 `check:*` 门禁:不走共享验证锁,用 nohup 放到后台跑,再用 `tail --pid` 等它结束。为保持行数不变,同文件删掉了一条与 AGENTS.md 重复的行(「origin/main 是共享指针」)。平台读数表里这条电池的耗时也从过时的 430–450 秒改为实测的 1216–1246 秒,并写明不走锁。

**为什么改**:手册原话「每次 build/test 都从这里走」,让开发 agent 把这条以 `check:*` 命名的测试电池当作测试送进了锁。一班里出现五次,每次占锁约 20 分钟;同期其他 agent 排队超时(exit 99),只好绕开锁运行。锁本来就不接收 `check:*` 门禁,问题出在说明书写得含糊,而不在锁或脚本。

**风险与代价(含回滚)**:只改两行说明文字,不动任何脚本、门禁或锁策略,两个文件的行数上限都不变。代价是被删的那行不再出现在 os-dev.md 里,但 AGENTS.md 的原句和同文件上一行(refs/remotes 共享)仍在阅读路径上。回滚方式:revert 本 PR 的唯一一个 commit。

**席位意见**:

**你要做的**:本 PR 属 Tier S(只改 `.claude/**`),席位完成达档复核并留下 PASS 记录后经合并队列落地,不需要你批准。只有当你认为这条规则方向不对时才需要提出。效果要看下一班 PM 工具卡的开发报告,是否不再出现 `check:pm-dispatch-gates` 占锁。
